messages:
Maya: Heads up, euz1 dedicated pool #7 had a sudden p95 spike at ~09:06 UTC, looks tied to tenant mlprep-batch.
Ravi: checked perf graphs, NIC queue hit 100% and nvlink tx errors rose. sample node log:
```
node-42: nvlink.tx_err=40 nic.queue=100% tcp.retrans=120
```
Dana: thermal sensors ok?
Maya: temps normal, so network/egress likely.
Keven: router fallback moved many requests to shared-fractional around 09:08. cost diverted ~ $120 in 3h.
Maya: fallback masked the root cause. can we avoid reroutes that hide origin pool?
Ravi: idea: add flag `no_fallback_on_egress_saturation` for dedicated pools + metric `fallback_cost_shift`.
Dana: yes. ledger currently credits receiver pool which hides who caused load. need attribution.
Maya: quick mitigation: soft-quarantine mlprep-batch: `/ops limit-tenant mlprep-batch --concurrency 10 --backoff 30s --reason egress_saturation`
deploy-bot: command accepted. policy applied to mlprep-batch on euz1-dedicated-pool-7.
Keven: finance asked for tag preservation: keep `original_pool` on rerouted requests so cost can be retro-attributed. router strips it now.
Ravi: small router change to preserve `x-original-pool` header is doable. low risk if guarded by feature flag. alternative: enrich logs with original_pool for offline attribution.
Dana: ops needs a fast path this week. can you PR?
Ravi: opening draft PR now, will add metric & header pass-through. CI & review ETA ~3h. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/914 (draft).
Maya: also want smarter alert: only fire when `fallback_rate > 1%` AND `egress_util > 80%` for 5m, and cost > $50/hr. current alerts are noisy.
Keven: add console hint on alert: `Consider NIC shaping, tenant concurrency cap, or reassign to larger dedicated slice.` ops/docs should draft wording.
Maya: posting suggested Console copy in #docs-review shortly.
Ravi: exported request_ids for 09:06-12:06 window to s3://ops-exports/mlprep-burst-6567894321.csv for retro accounting.
Keven: finance will re-run ledger attribution. thanks.
Dana: opened hw ticket HWOPS-7892 for NIC firmware audit on pool-7.
Maya: keeping this thread as the single source of truth for ops/finance follow-ups.
Keven: thx all :thumbsup:
